summary: Build digital MEAL systems skills for registries, MIS integration, mobile data, privacy, and dashboards. Enrol in practical training.
lede: Digital MEAL and social protection data system design connects beneficiary records, programme measures and reporting through clear data governance. For MEAL managers, programme leads and data-system staff, it addresses planning traceable workflows from registration and eligibility to services and outcome reporting. Participants practise mapping data lifecycles, shaping registry data models and quality controls, specifying mobile collection and MIS/ERP exchanges, and outlining privacy safeguards and dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for building, governing, integrating, or using digital MEAL systems across social protection and large multi-stakeholder programmes.
prerequisites: You should have working experience in MEAL, social protection programme delivery, information management, registry operations, or MIS administration. Familiarity with indicators, reporting cycles, spreadsheets, and stakeholder coordination will help, but software development experience is not required. Coding and programming are not required for completion. Advanced topics such as API architecture, AI-assisted analysis, and enterprise integration are taught at conceptual and operational application level, while mobile form design, data dictionaries, governance registers, and dashboard specifications receive hands-on practice.
